notes.title: NEW MAP: Squirrel Garden!
notes.content:
Aright its time for a local lockdown, which means more ESD updates, like THIS ONE.

Get yourself a new map with a new element - moving platforms. And another new element - a giant squirrel! AND ANOTHER NEW ELEMENT - fire! Oh that one already exists? Oh my Gaia! I'll take it back!

New map also has it's own music, little snippet here:

[previewyoutube=uPOfGAiqtWo;full][/previewyoutube]

Full changelog:

 New map
 Fixed the big cough for good
 Changed the menu
 Mouse input now works fine
 Removed horrid grunt sounds, replaced with much nice grunt sounds
 Added new attack and falling animations
 Added music/sounds volume controls to the in-game pause menu
 Lowered default music volume


There's a new mode planned for the next proper update, we'll see how long lockdown lasts.

notes.title: ESD: ZOMBIES
notes.content:
ZOMBIE UPDATE LIVE
This update contains a new map, the haunted forest. Creepy fog, spooky yet punchy music, and of course unlimited zombies who carry the infection on their sharpened... fingers? You can't limit their personal freedoms by requiring them to wear gloves!

[previewyoutube=nUz7gCht51Q;full][/previewyoutube]

There is also now a new isolation mode! Zombies tests your survival skills against an increasing number of moaning, gasping, clumsily moving, non-gender-specific, adjective-collecting zombies!

The new guys move a bit slow, they attack a bit slow, and if they do hit, they have a 58/116 chance of infecting you. One good punch from you will render them useless and therefore will be removed from the universe. The good news is, that they never stop coming!

Never!

This update also includes two new achievements! Both deal with zombies. Who'da thunk? Are you da thunk? Thank Anubis - I've been looking for you everywhere!

notes.title: Even better punching
notes.content:
In this update:

Punching is now a lot smoother.
Punching is now more powerful.
The AI now punches slightly quicker.
The AI now makes decisions a little faster.
The correct music plays for the boxing ring.
Fixed the stat screen not coming up sometimes.


That's it, not much to it! If anybody want to play me using Remote connect hit me up!

Thank you so much for playing the game, it means a lot to me. I hope you achieve all achievements, crack the Easter eggs, and appreciate the usage of the Oxford comma.

Cheers!

notes.title: BOXING UPDATE Now Live
notes.content:
The BOXING UPDATE is now live!

[previewyoutube=F3_JRX7pVeY;full][/previewyoutube]

In this update there is a new arena to practise extreme social distancing - the boxing ring! Punch, cough, and hoard toilet paper while hundreds of coloured eggs snap your pics, mourn the financial repercussions of buying the tickets, and make plans to get the winner's name tattooed on their sternum forever.

Matches held in the ring should be over much quicker, due to the confined space, the ability to bounce off the ropes, and the pressure of such a large crowd watching your every move.

Also included:

 Punches now force opponents towards the centre more strongly
 Mars has much less gravity (more bouncy bouncy, yay!)
 Disabled mouse input for menus

​Bug fixes:

 No longer able to sit in with the sicko
